description: Budget delivery (pacing) mode lookup for one or more PLA campaigns: returns budget_delivery_mode (ACCELERATED vs STANDARD) per campaign_id (marketing_campaign_id) from marketing_campaign_dimensions. Point-in-time dimension lookup (no date range), keyed by a mandatory campaign_id filter; the Python layer buckets ids into accelerated/standard/not-found and computes the summary counts.

campaign_id.description: The PLA campaign id (marketing_campaign_id). Per-call filter: pass one or more ids to look up their budget delivery mode.

budget_delivery_mode.description: The budget delivery (pacing) mode configured on the campaign: ACCELERATED (spend as fast as possible) vs STANDARD (spread evenly across the day).

placeholder_metric.description: Constant 0 placeholder so the attribute-only dimension report satisfies the fetch requirement of at least one metric; carries no meaning.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions` AS mcd JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.clients` AS clients ON clients.client_id = mcd.client_id WHERE clients.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
